_about: The Anomalous Force Protein (weight_booster, 339) also throws grenades 15 % farther while in a pocket (the owner, 2026-11-05): a built-in modification 1320 of player modifier 27 (grenade_throw_power, the Grenadier skill's: throw speed x max(0, 1 + S27), 0x30A2DE), +0.15 as the booster's +5 kg (1124), docs/notes/force-protein.md. Its card line is property 174 (Throwing distance, a percentage like 105). The booster gets the key its modification changes, as every booster has those of its own. boosters.tsv makes 1320 the booster's built-in (column throw_distance), modifications.tsv holds its row.
